title: Senior Backend Developer CrewAI/Python
description:
A Mouts busca um profissional experiente para atuar no desenvolvimento de uma plataforma corporativa de agentes inteligentes, construída em arquitetura de microsserviços e executada em ambiente Azure. O foco central da posição é a orquestração, integração e observabilidade de agentes CrewAI em um ecossistema corporativo global.


Modelo de atuação: Remoto

Conheça mais sobre a Mouts: mouts.info


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada com CrewAI .
  • Conhecimento em LLM APIs (OpenAI / Azure OpenAI).
  • Experiência sólida com Node.js e .NET .
  • Domínio no desenvolvimento de APIs REST .
  • Experiência em arquitetura de microsserviços .
  • Vivência com PostgreSQL e bancos vetoriais .
  • Experiência com CI/CD .
  • Atuação prévia em ambiente Azure .
  • Inglês básico a intermediário.


Responsabilidades Principais

  • Desenvolvimento de serviços backend para orquestração de agentes CrewAI.
  • Construção de integrações entre agentes e sistemas corporativos.
  • Implementação de pipelines de execução, estados e controle de agentes.
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs REST para gestão e consumo de agentes.
  • Integração com mensageria (EventHub).
  • Implementação de mecanismos de logging, métricas e rastreabilidade.
  • Atuação conjunta com Arquitetura e DevOps em soluções Azure-native.
  • Garantia de qualidade, performance e segurança do ecossistema.
  • Desenvolvimento de testes automatizados.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com frameworks de agentes (LangGraph, Autogen, entre outros).
  • Experiência com arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.
  • Conhecimento em práticas de observabilidade.
  • Vivência com Inteligência Artificial aplicada.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
Position Summary:


Our partner, a growing streaming and marketing optimization product company, is looking to add a BI Analyst to its team. In this role, your focus will be on analyzing operational business data and transforming it into meaningful insights and actionable strategies. You will collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, extract and analyze data from various platforms, and create actionable reports. You will play a key role in providing valuable insights and supporting data-driven decision-making across the organization. Therefore, the ideal candidate should have a strong analytical mindset, excellent data manipulation skills, and a passion for transforming data into actionable business intelligence.


Experience and Education:


  • Bachelor's or higher degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, or a related technical field/experience.
  • 3+ years of experience as a BI Analyst or in a similar data-focused role.
  • Experienced in SQL and advanced SQL queries, to extract and manipulate data.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling concepts and how to design effective data structures for reporting and analysis.


Skills and Strengths:


  • SQL Queries
  • MySQL
  • SQL Server
  • PostgreSQL
  • Power BI
  • Tableau
  • BI Analysis
  • Data Visualization & Reporting (Google Looker Preferred)
  • Business Presentations
  • Stakeholder Management & Communication
  • Python (a plus)


Primary Job Responsibilities:


  • Collect and extract data from SQL databases using advanced queries and data modeling.
  • Utilize data analysis techniques to uncover trends, patterns, and actionable insights from complex datasets.
  • Develop reports to provide valuable insights to stakeholders that will support data-driven decision-making.
  • Work closely with business stakeholders to understand and identify business needs and document reporting requirements.
  • Develop predictive models and forecasting tools to anticipate future trends and outcomes, helping in strategic planning.
  • Ensure accuracy and consistency in reporting by validating data integrity.
  • Maintain documentation of reports, queries, and data processes.
  • Identify opportunities to improve data-related processes, data quality, and reporting efficiency, resolving data discrepancies or inconsistencies.
  • Stay updated with the latest BI trends, tools, and technologies, incorporating best practices into work, to improve reporting capabilities.

title: Estágio Confeitaria
description:
ESTÁGIO EM CONFEITARIA


No Copacabana Palace, A Belmond Hotel — um dos hotéis mais icônicos do mundo, reconhecido como o 11º melhor do planeta e o melhor da América do Sul pelo ranking The World’s 50 Best Hotels 2025 — cada criação é feita com propósito e paixão.

Nossa confeitaria transforma ingredientes em emoções e memórias, oferecendo uma oportunidade única para quem deseja construir uma carreira brilhante na gastronomia, aprendendo com mestres em um ambiente de excelência que une tradição e inovação.


O que esperamos de você:


  • Colaborar na criação e preparo de sobremesas, massas e doces.
  • Auxiliar na montagem e finalização, garantindo o padrão da apresentação, sabor e harmonia em cada detalhe;
  • Cuidar do mise en place e da organização da cozinha, contribuindo para um ambiente fluido e inspirador;
  • Praticar os mais altos padrões de segurança de alimentos, higiene e aproveitamento responsável dos insumos;
  • Apoiar o controle de estoque e a identificação dos produtos, garantindo qualidade e excelência em cada etapa.


Requisitos


  • Estar cursando Ensino Superior em Gastronomia;
  • Ter conhecimento das normas de Segurança de Alimentos;
  • Disponibilidade para estagiar das 08h00 às 15h00 ou das 15h00 às 22h00.
  • Paixão por confeitaria e por gastronomia.
  • Comprometido, curiosidade e dedicação, com desejo genuíno de evoluir em um ambiente de excelência.


Benefícios

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico extensivo a dependentes diretos.
  • Vale-transporte - abrangente para todas as modalidades: metrô, ônibus e trem.
  • Convênio Farmácia.
  • Alimentação no local.
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Folga de Aniversário
  • Escala 5 x 2
  • Descontos nos pontos de vendas da empresa.
  • De acordo com o seu “tempo de casa”, você adquiri diárias e experiências gratuitas nas propriedades da Belmond ao redor do mundo, incluindo 50% de desconto em Alimentos & Bebidas.


Nos esforçamos para criar um ambiente onde nossas(os) colaboradoras(es) possam prosperar tanto pessoal quanto profissionalmente. Com um compromisso em seu desenvolvimento contínuo, você terá a oportunidade de aprender e crescer ao lado de alguns dos indivíduos mais talentosos do setor. Junte-se a nós e faça parte da criação de momentos inesquecíveis para nossos hóspedes, comunidades e uns aos outros.

Este é o seu momento. Inscreva-se hoje!


Sobre nós

Um refúgio atemporal no coração de uma cidade movimentada. Um estilo de vida cosmopolita encontra o glamour do mundo antigo no Copacabana Palace. Com bares icônicos, restaurantes com estrela Michelin e um Spa estão todos esperando para serem descobertos dentro de suas paredes art déco.

Inicie sua jornada profissional no mundo da hospitalidade no ícone brasileiro à beira-mar com mais de um século de história.


A Belmond & a família LVMH

Nós do Copacabana Palace, somos orgulhosos em fazer parte da LVMH e da coleção global de hotéis, trens e cruzeiros fluviais Belmond, todos criando experiências excepcionais em todo o mundo. Quando você se junta à nossa propriedade, você se torna parte de uma família global de hotéis ricos em história e destinos deslumbrantes, onde nossas(os) colaboradoras(es) estão no centro da experiência Belmond.

title: Computational Scientist
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties

We seek a talented Computational Scientist with an M.Sc. in Computational Science or Engineering and academic and/or professional experience. A Ph.D. degree with a strong background in Computational Science is a plus. The ideal candidate for this position is an expert in porting complex scientific programming codes to parallel hybrid (CPU+GPU) clusters. You must have a passion for optimizing and improving code speed-up. Excellent problem-solving ability and good oral and written communication skills in both English and Portuguese are required.

You will join a multidisciplinary and diverse team of scientists and engineers committed to delivering high-end computational technologies and tools for the O&G and broader Energy industry.


Qualifications

  • Expert knowledge of modern C++ (e.g., C++11, C++14, C++17).
  • Expert knowledge of GPGPU frameworks/software layers such as CUDA and OpenCL.
  • Expert knowledge of distributed and parallel computing in hybrid (CPU and GPU) clusters.
  • Good knowledge of device-level optimization and GPU architecture.
  • Good knowledge of modern C++ design patterns and software engineering concepts (e.g., template metaprogramming, generic programming, etc.).
  • Ability to work in both Windows and Linux environments.
  • Some experience with programming/scripting languages such as Python and Matlab.
  • Some experience with MPI programming.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Proven experience porting legacy serial or MPI/OpenMP code to GPUs.
  • Knowledge of scientific computing (e.g., linear and nonlinear solvers, numerical methods, etc.).
  • Familiarity with computational mathematics (e.g., linear algebra, calculus, matrix decompositions, etc.).
  • Knowledge of PDE discretization methods, such as Finite Element, Finite Volume, or Lattice Boltzmann.
  • Familiarity with open-source scientific computing libraries (e.g., HYPRE, BOOST++, PETSC, DUNE, LAPACK, etc.).
  • Familiarity with CMake, Makefiles, and other tools for multi-platform code compilation.
  • Knowledge of fluid flow physics.

title: Director of Salesforce Implementation
description:
Position Overview


The Director of Salesforce Implementation will lead a team of up to 15 Salesforce professionals across the US and LATAM, including consultants, developers, administrators, solution architects, and marketing automation specialists (MCAE and MCE). This role is responsible for project delivery excellence, ensuring projects are scoped accurately, executed effectively, delivered on time, and aligned with client expectations and IMG quality standards. The ideal candidate combines deep Salesforce expertise with proven team leadership, project governance, delivery operations, and client relationship skills. This director will serve as the operational leader of the implementation team, optimizing processes, reviewing time and utilization, providing coaching, managing escalations, and driving exceptional customer satisfaction.


Key Responsibilities


Team Leadership and Management

  • Lead and mentor a cross-functional Salesforce implementation team across US and LATAM.
  • Provide coaching, one-on-ones, growth planning, and performance management.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and high-quality delivery.
  • Manage staffing, capacity planning, and resource allocation across all active projects.


Project and Delivery Oversight

  • Oversee all Salesforce implementation projects including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (MCAE), Marketing Cloud Engagement (MCE), and integrations.
  • Conduct regular project reviews to ensure progress, scope alignment, and adherence to timelines.
  • Monitor time tracking, utilization, and project budgets; identify trends and address over-burn or under-delivery risks.
  • Establish and refine delivery processes, best practices, and standard operating procedures.


Quality Control and Customer Satisfaction

  • Ensure projects meet IMG quality standards and deliver measurable business value.
  • Provide strategic oversight and intervention on escalations or complex project challenges.
  • Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction through proactive communication and alignment.
  • Partner with the Sales team during handoff to ensure a smooth transition from scoping to delivery.


Operational Excellence

  • Develop and maintain predictable implementation workflows and project governance frameworks.
  • Improve reporting and tracking across project health, timelines, scope changes, and team utilization.
  • Implement delivery tools, templates, documentation standards, and internal QA processes.
  • Collaborate with leadership on forecasting, hiring needs, and Salesforce practice growth.


Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, and Operations teams to ensure alignment across the client lifecycle.
  • Participate in internal strategic planning, service-offering refinement, and productization of Salesforce packages such as Jumpstart.
  • Support revenue growth by identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities during implementation.


Qualifications


Required

  • 7 or more years of Salesforce implementation experience (consulting or client-side).
  • 3 or more years leading technical or consulting teams, preferably remote or geographically distributed.
  • Strong knowledge of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and marketing automation platforms (MCAE and MCE).
  • Proven ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects and large-scale client engagements.
  • Experience with resource planning, time tracking, utilization reporting, and delivery KPIs.
  • Strong communication, leadership, and conflict resolution skills.

Resumo da Função: Excelência em Recrutamento de Nível Concierge

Estamos buscando um Analista de Recrutamento Júnior para oferecer um serviço de recrutamento "white glove" e de nível concierge para nosso estimado cliente farmacêutico, com foco no mercado brasileiro. Esta função exige um indivíduo de natureza polida, orientado a processos e que possua uma forte mentalidade de serviço com habilidades de comunicação superiores e uma atenção aguçada aos detalhes.

O Que Você Fará

A função principal desta posição é gerenciar o recrutamento de ciclo completo com a disciplina meticulosa exigida para perfis de indústria complexos (por exemplo, Produtos Farmacêuticos, Dispositivos Médicos, Aviação).

  • Conformidade de Processos e Administração de Sistemas: Garantir estabilidade em funções anteriores e gerenciar processos complexos com estrita aderência à conformidade do processo de recrutamento e à administração do Sistema de Rastreamento de Candidatos (ATS).

  • Experiência: Um mínimo de 1+ ano em uma função de suporte direto a funções de recrutamento e experiência comprovada em recrutamento de ciclo completo por pelo menos um ano.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including:
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels;
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institution limits and capital requirements;
  • Net-worth monitoring.
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: MSP Delivery Specialist (Bilingual English | Portuguese)
description:
About Pinnacle Group

Pinnacle Group is a trusted leader in workforce solutions and managed service provider (MSP) operations. We partner with enterprise clients to streamline contingent workforce management, strengthen supplier relationships, and ensure program compliance. Our mission is to deliver operational excellence through technology-driven solutions, industry expertise, and exceptional service quality across all facets of workforce delivery.


Summary

Pinnacle Group is seeking an MSP Delivery Specialist to manage the full life cycle of contingent workforce requests. This role serves as a key point of contact for client hiring managers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders, ensuring seamless requisition management, compliance, and operational success. The ideal candidate has strong experience in recruitment, MSP operations, and Vendor Management Systems (VMS), combined with a customer service mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.


Job Description

  • Train, assist, and facilitate the requisition life cycle with client hiring managers and suppliers.
  • Support large-scale hiring initiatives, VMS data integrity projects, and supplier rationalization efforts.
  • Conduct intake calls, qualify candidate resumes, and manage requisition flow from posting through fulfillment.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with hiring managers, suppliers, and internal program teams to ensure program success.
  • Maintain a service-focused approach, delivering a high-quality experience to all stakeholders.
  • Utilize and provide training on MSP tool such as Beeline and applications including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Ensure timely and accurate submission of required documentation by suppliers, maintaining adherence to SLAs and KPIs.
  • Support reporting, analytics, and client-specific initiatives as assigned.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience, preferably in a business-related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in MSP operations, or contingent workforce management .
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and experience with Beeline
  • Bilingual Competency across English and Portuguese
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts clearly.
  • Proven success in a client-facing, fast-paced, and service-oriented environment.
  • Self-starter who can work independently and exercise sound judgment in ambiguous situations.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities with a solution-driven mindset.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy under tight deadlines.


Why Join Pinnacle Group?

At Pinnacle Group, you’ll play a vital role in advancing workforce solutions that power some of the world’s leading organizations. We foster a collaborative environment that encourages innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth. You’ll have the opportunity to strengthen your MSP expertise, build strategic relationships, and make a meaningful impact in a company that values excellence and accountability.


Compensation and Benefits Disclosure

The specific compensation for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role as well as the cost of labor in the market; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. Our full-time consultants have access to benefits including medical, dental, vision and 401K contributions as well as any other PTO, sick leave, and other benefits mandated by appliable state or localities where you reside or work.

title: Anti-Money Laundering Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
  • Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
  • Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
  • Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings with COAF or relevant authorities.
  • Monitor developments in AML/CFT and sanctions laws, and assist in updating internal procedures accordingly.
  • Assist in the delivery of internal training and awareness sessions on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance.
  • Conduct periodic risk assessments, ensuring all controls are operating effectively and aligned with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all compliance reviews, escalations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits, as well as inspections or information requests from regulators.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to strengthen compliance systems and data integrity.
  • Contribute to the assessment and oversight of third-party vendors that support AML/CFT and compliance operations.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience in financial, fintech, or VASP sectors.
  • Proven ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense.
  • Strong understanding of COAF, Central Bank of Brazil, and CVM regulations, as well as FATF standards.
  • Proficient in KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or related field; postgraduate or certification (e.g., CAMS, ICA) preferred.
  • Excellent analytical skills, professional integrity, and fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

description:
ServiceNow Technical Expert

Organization: BEXIT (Business Excellence & IT Strategy)

Reporting: Reports to Christian Daller, Head of BEXIT

Position Type: Individual Contributor


Role Description:

The ServiceNow Technical Expert will play a pivotal role in building and evolving ServiceNow as the “IT ERP” for the newco IT organization. This individual will take hands-on architectural decisions, guide and supervise external partners in development and application management, and directly contribute to configuration, development, and administration of ServiceNow. The role will consult and guide on architectural and configuration decisions across a broad range of modules—including SPM, ITSM, ITOM, HR, VR, custom apps, integrations, and more—ensuring ServiceNow meets the needs of a modern, integrated IT landscape.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Make hands-on architectural decisions for ServiceNow configuration and development.

  • Investigate and advise on module usage, integrations, and platform capabilities across such as, but not limited to, SPM, ITSM, ITOM, HR, VR, and custom applications.
  • Ensure platform design follows best practices and avoids unnecessary customization or technical debt.
  • Represent BEXIT as a subject matter expert in cross-functional meetings and initiatives
  • Training: Provide Training regarding ServiceNow stretching from End Users to Technical Staff and Architects.


Expectations:

  • Prioritize out-of-the-box functionality and avoid custom development unless justified by business case, legal, EHS, or security requirements.
  • Follow ServiceNow best practices to ensure scalability, maintainability, and minimal technical debt.
  • Demonstrate proactive problem-solving and consultative guidance across modules.
  • Maintain clear and effective communication with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure all architectural decisions are aligned with the enterprise roadmap and scoped demands.


Qualifications:

  • Must-Have: ServiceNow Administrator certification or equivalent. Additional certifications in the context of ITIL functionality are beneficial.
  • Proven experience in scripting and integration within ServiceNow.
  • Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills.
  • Basic knowledge of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid).


  • Nice-to-Have: Familiarity with architectural frameworks such as CSDM and TOGAF.
  • Experience across multiple ServiceNow modules.
  • Understanding of enterprise IT transformation and ERP-like platform design.


Authorization:

  • Make architectural and configuration decisions within the roadmap provided by the Enterprise Architect and the scope defined by Process Owners and DSMs.
  • Represent BEXIT in cross-functional meetings and initiatives as a subject matter expert (SME).
  • Approve configuration and development work that aligns with best practices and avoids unnecessary customization or technical debt.
  • Guide and supervise external partners in development and application management activities.

title: Infrastructure automation engineer
description:
Title: Infrastructure automation engineer

Location: Remote


The Lead, Infrastructure automation engineer role is part of the Cloud and Compute engineering organisation to drive an improved developer experience and automation first approach for adoption of public and hybrid cloud computing environment in a secured manner. This role will be passionate about developing cloud-agnostic infrastructure provisioning and lifecycle management automation, ensuring associated security and compliance guardrails to meet application hosting requirements. The role is foran individual contributor who will develop Terraform, Chef and Python REST API based automation for automated provisioning, change, and decommission of VM, IaaS and PaaS database and Cloud resources in public cloud AWS, Azure, GCP and private cloud.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and enforce CIS security standards for Windows and Linux operating systems using Chef or similar configuration management tools.
  • Deliver new cloud services to the business, while simplifying and improving service consumption and operational management
  • Leverage Python REST APIs to develop “Zero” touch provisioning, patching, change and decommissioning of VM, Kubernetes, PaaS database for lifecycle management of Hybrid Cloud resources.
  • Develop REST APIs in python using BDD methodology and implement public cloud security guardrails.
  • Partner with Kenvue application teams for proof of technology in public cloud computing environment.
  • Build Hybrid Cloud infrastructure provisioning workflows leveraging continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines (CI/CD) running on Jenkins and or other CI CD tools.
  • Partner with Kenvue application teams and drive resolution of sophisticated technical problems across infrastructure and application stack.
  • Design, engineer, implement Infrastructure As Code with API first and microservices based approach for public cloud service.
  • Leverage internal and external resources to develop, advance and retain talent.
  • Review current processes and find opportunities for automation and build common frameworks in agile manner that cultivate adoption of automation across all layers.
  • Groom Jira features and stories to improve reliability and reduce support incidents for global infrastructure

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree required, preferably in STEM field.
  • 5 years of progressive experience in a combination of development, design in areas of cloud computing and infrastructure engineering.
  • Strong Infrastructure as a Code (IaC) experience on hybrid cloud environment,
  • Observability, through tools such as Prometheus, Elasticsearch, Grafana, DataDog or Zipkin is a plus.
  • 2+ years hands-on experience in Chef or similar config management tool is required
  • 2+ years hands-on experience in AWS, Azure, or GCP is required
  • Experience building Restful APIs is required.
  • 1+ year of Terraform experience.
  • Experience in Kubernetes is preferred
  • VMware experience is preferred.
  • Open-Source virtualization experience like KVM and Ovirt is preferred.
  • Understanding of GIT-based source code management, Continuous Integration, and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices using tools like Jenkins, Bitbucket, Artifactory, Groovy Scripting
  • Strong understanding of agile development processes and Agile tool set JIRA Python development experience is preferred but development experience with one or more of the following languages may be acceptable: Go, Scala, Java, Ruby, Python
  • Experience in supporting global operations and following enterprise level process frameworks. Good social, oral and written communication skills are preferred.
  • Self-starter with positive relationship abilities and customer service skills is preferred

title: FPGA Engineer (Brazil) | Engenheiro(a) de FPGA (Brasil)
description:
The Opportunity

Grass Valley’s FPGA Engineers develop state-of-the -art solutions for content creation, transmission, and distribution. We are dedicated to redefining the way audiences experience entertainment and information through cutting-edge technology. We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced FPGA Engineer specializing in Broadcast Video and Audio to join our team. As a FPGA Engineer, you will be instrumental in the design, development, testing and implementation of FPGA-based solutions specifically tailored for broadcast video and audio applications. Your responsibilities will encompass leading FPGA architecture design, electronic and PCB design and collaborating with cross-functional teams to integrate these solutions into our broadcast systems.


Your Role

  • Lead the architecture, design, and development of FPGA-based systems for broadcast video and audio applications, focusing on Embedded System hardware and electronic design;
  • Optimize FPGA designs to enhance video processing, audio synchronization and develop electronic systems with FPGA architectures;
  • Conduct thorough simulation, testing, debugging, and verification of FPGA designs to ensure seamless functionality and adherence to industry standards;
  • Maintain and improve FPGA build processes using CI/CD tools like Jenkins;
  • Estimate work effort to establish schedules for design delivery;
  • Stay updated on industry trends, emerging standards, and technologies related to broadcast video and audio.


Who you are

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related technical field;
  • Two (2) to five (5) years experience in FPGA design and development with strong focus on electronic and PCB design;
  • Proficiency in FPGA design, power estimation, implementation, optimization, testing, and development using hardware description languages (HDL) such as VHDL or Verilog;
  • Ability to simulate and verify FPGA designs using tools like Questa;
  • Familiarity with FPGA development tools such as Xilinx Vivado, or Altera Quartus;
  • Proficiency in debugging and troubleshooting FPGA designs, including using logic analyzers and other debugging tools;
  • Ability to create clear and concise documentation for FPGA designs, including design specifications;
  • Experience with embedded system integration and real-time operating systems running on inhouse designed hardware;
  • Experience in high-speed digital design, data serialization, media streaming (ST2110) and transmission protocols within the broadcast industry, particularly HD-SDI video;
  • Experience with high-speed serial interfaces like PCIe, DDR, Ethernet, and USB;
  • Knowledge of communication protocols such as SPI, I2C, UART, and CAN;
  • Strong understanding of digital logic design principles and ability to create complex digital circuits;
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python and programming languages C/C++ for FPGA programming and automation;
  • Understanding TCP/IP from network programming perspective;
  • Experience in managing code with version control systems like Git to track releases and collaborate with a team through branching and merging;
  • Strong teamwork and communication skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional multi-site teams, including hardware engineers, QA engineers, and project managers;
  • Proven experience in hardware design and development, preferably in a similar role;
  • Experience with hardware debug and tests;
  • Strong knowledge of analog and digital electronics, microcontrollers, and FPGA;
  • Familiarity with industry standards, regulations, and compliance related to hardware design;
  • Proficiency in schematic capture and oversight of PCB layout;
  • Fluency in English, both oral and written.


Working Conditions

  • Competitive Compensation packages
  • Energizing and supportive work environment
  • Remote work

______________________________________________________________

  • This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work involved for this job. It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of this job.
  • Grass Valley is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to gender, marital status, race, religion, colour, age, disability, sexual orientation or protected veteran status.

_______________________________________________________________


Oportunidade


Os Engenheiros FPGA da Grass Valley desenvolvem soluções de ponta para criação, transmissão e distribuição de conteúdo. Somos dedicados a redefinir a forma como as audiências vivenciam entretenimento e informação por meio de tecnologia inovadora.


Estamos buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) FPGA altamente qualificado(a) e experiente, especializado(a) em Vídeo e Áudio Broadcast, para integrar nossa equipe. Como Engenheiro(a) FPGA você será fundamental no design, desenvolvimento, teste e implementação de soluções baseadas em FPGA, especificamente voltadas para aplicações de Vídeo e Áudio Broadcast. Suas responsabilidades incluirão liderar o design de arquitetura FPGA, design eletrônico e de PCB, além de colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para integrar essas soluções aos nossos sistemas de transmissão.


Função

  • Liderar a arquitetura, design e desenvolvimento de sistemas baseados em FPGA para aplicações de vídeo e áudio broadcast, com foco em hardware de sistemas embarcados e design eletrônico;
  • Otimizar designs FPGA para aprimorar o processamento de vídeo, sincronização de áudio e desenvolver sistemas eletrônicos com arquiteturas FPGA;
  • Realizar simulação, testes, depuração e verificação detalhada dos designs FPGA para garantir funcionalidade perfeita e conformidade com padrões da indústria;
  • Manter e melhorar processos de build FPGA usando ferramentas CI/CD como Jenkins;
  • Estimar esforço de trabalho para estabelecer cronogramas de entrega de design;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências da indústria, padrões emergentes e tecnologias relacionadas a vídeo e áudio broadcast.


Quem é você

  • Graduado em Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia da Computação ou área técnica relacionada;
  • De 2 a 5 anos de experiência em design e desenvolvimento FPGA com forte foco em design eletrônico e de PCB;
  • Proficiência em design FPGA, estimativa de consumo, implementação, otimização, testes e desenvolvimento usando linguagens de descrição de hardware (HDL) como VHDL ou Verilog;
  • Capacidade de simular e verificar designs FPGA usando ferramentas como Questa;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de desenvolvimento FPGA como Xilinx Vivado ou Altera Quartus;
  • Proficiência em depuração e solução de problemas em designs FPGA, incluindo uso de analisadores lógicos e outras ferramentas de debug;
  • Capacidade de criar documentação clara e concisa para designs FPGA, incluindo especificações de design;
  • Experiência com integração de sistemas embarcados e sistemas operacionais em tempo real rodando em hardware desenvolvido internamente;
  • Experiência em design digital de alta velocidade, serialização de dados, streaming de mídia (ST2110) e protocolos de transmissão na indústria broadcast, especialmente vídeo HD-SDI;
  • Experiência com interfaces seriais de alta velocidade como PCIe, DDR, Ethernet e USB;
  • Conhecimento de protocolos de comunicação como SPI, I2C, UART e CAN;
  • Forte compreensão dos princípios de design lógico digital e capacidade de criar circuitos digitais complexos;
  • Proficiência em linguagens de script como Python e linguagens de programação C/C++ para programação FPGA e automação;
  • Compreensão de TCP/IP sob a perspectiva de programação de rede;
  • Experiência em gerenciamento de código com sistemas de controle de versão como Git para rastrear releases e colaborar com a equipe por meio de branching e merging;
  • Fortes habilidades de trabalho em equipe e comunicação para colaborar efetivamente com equipes multifuncionais distribuídas, incluindo engenheiros de hardware, QA e gerentes de projeto;
  • Experiência comprovada em design e desenvolvimento de hardware, preferencialmente em função similar;
  • Experiência com debug e testes de hardware;
  • Sólido conhecimento em eletrônica analógica e digital, microcontroladores e FPGA;
  • Familiaridade com padrões da indústria, regulamentações e conformidade relacionadas ao design de hardware;
  • Proficiência em captura esquemática e supervisão de layout de PCB;
  • Fluência em inglês, oral e escrita.

  • Ambiente de trabalho estimulante e colaborativo

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Join Aerial Core - the back office that keeps pace with your ambition


Aerial Core is a modern, tech-enabled back-office partner that supports growing businesses through accounting, finance, and people operations services. We’ve intentionally broken the mold of traditional accounting firms by placing relationships, collaboration, and innovation at the center of how we work.


At Aerial Core, we believe accounting should be more than compliance,  it should be strategic, insightful, and human-driven. Our people-first culture values trust, independence, and efficiency, empowering every team member to do their best work while helping clients thrive.


We’re now looking for a tech-savvy, detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join our remote team. Please be informed that this is a contractor position and we will require your CNPJ. This is the perfect opportunity for professionals who value autonomy, flexibility and performance based rewards. You’ll work directly with clients, manage their day-to-day financial operations, and leverage technology to deliver accurate, timely, and strategic bookkeeping support.


What You'll Do

  • Handle full-cycle bookkeeping for assigned clients, including AP/AR, bank reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Maintain accurate financial data using QuickBooks or other cloud-based accounting tools.
  • Prepare clear, insightful financial reports that help clients make better decisions.
  • Communicate with clients and team members through Slack, Zoom, and Google Workspace.
  • Use Financial Cents to track projects, deliverables, and timelines.
  • Proactively identify ways to improve processes, automate tasks, and increase efficiency.
  • Prepare necessary documentation and reports for internal and external audit processes.
  • Ensure compliance with accounting standards and Aerial Core’s quality expectations.


What We're Looking For

  • Fluent in English
  • Proven experience in bookkeeping or accounting 
  • Flexibility around working hours, with the understanding that some tasks may require availability during US business hours (mainly Pacific Time)
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and accuracy
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to manage multiple clients independently
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment using digital tools.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Financial Cents or any other workflow automation tools
  • Familiarity with CRMs or project management systems such as Asana
  • Prior experience working with startups or small businesses


Why You'll Love Working With Us

At Aerial Core, we do things differently:

  • Trust and Independence: You are your own boss. We trust your expertise and give you the freedom to manage your time and workload.
  • Efficiency and Innovation: We embrace technology and encourage experimentation. If you find a better way to work, we’ll support it.
  • Collaboration and Growth: We win as a team. Our culture is built on helping each other, learning together, and celebrating shared success.
  • Performance-Driven Rewards: Your efforts directly impact your earnings. You’ll receive a retainer contract of R$3,300 with the option to qualify for more contracts. 
  • Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere, anytime as long as deadlines are met and excellence is maintained.


The Aerial Core Way

  • Relationships over Transactions: We build lasting relationships by deeply understanding our clients and delivering real value.
  • Strategic Thinking & Judgment: We go beyond the surface, identifying root causes and providing actionable insights.
  • Open Communication: We value transparency and see mistakes as opportunities for growth.
  • Excellence & Accountability: We aim for 10/10 work — delivered early, reviewed thoroughly, and executed with care.


Ready to do accounting differently?

Join a modern, digital-first team where your independence, innovation, and impact truly matter.

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


Ei Profissional venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!



  • O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


  • O que você deve ter?
  • Experiência sólida com Node.js e desenvolvimento de APIs
  • Domínio de .NET (C#) e ASP.NET Core
  • Conhecimento avançado em Angular (preferencialmente versões 20+)
  • Experiência com PostgreSQL
  • Conhecimento em MongoDB e/ou DocumentDB
  • Versionamento com Git
  • Conhecimento em TypeScript
  • Inglês intermediário

⭐ Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Experiência com NestJS
  • Arquitetura de microserviços
  • Arquitetura de microfrontend
  • Familiaridade com Docker
  • Experiência com cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)
  • Ferramentas de CI/CD
  • RxJS e programação reativa
  • Testes unitários e de integração (Jest, xUnit)
  • Conhecimento em design patterns

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS )
  • Familiaridade com práticas DevOps


O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 etapas:

- Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

- Mobilidade Interna: Você quer um novo rumo profissional? Aqui dentro de casa temos diversas opções diferentes e o programa de mobilidade interna, que te permite mudar de área, por exemplo.

- Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

- Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Customer Support Representative, Level 1
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are seeking an experienced Customer Support Representative to be on the front lines by answering questions and troubleshooting technical problems. You will assist customers with JoVE’s products and also guide clients through any technical issue they might encounter. If you are an energetic self-starter problem solver with a basic technical background and excellent communication skills, we want to talk to you. The Support Team here at JoVE is providing support not only to external customers but also to internal JoVE employees on a 24x7 basis.



Responsibilities:


  • Manage large amounts of incoming tickets.
  • Provide support to answer inquiries on products.
  • Accept and handle technical requests.
  • Triage tickets to the correct L2 teams.
  • Follow communication procedures, guidelines and policies.
  • Provide accurate, valid and complete information by using the right methods/tools.
  • Build sustainable relationships and trust with customers through open communication.
  • Handle customer complaints, provide appropriate solutions and alternatives within the time limits; follow up to ensure resolution.
  • Keep records of customer interactions, process customer accounts and file documents.
  • Take the extra mile to engage customers.
  • Performs other specific duties or assignments as directed by Team Manager.


Skills And Qualifications:


  • A Bachelor’s in Computer Science or related field.
  • 2+ years of demonstrable experience in customer support.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, verbal and written, are required to effectively and accurately communicate in English.
  • Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical personnel in a clear and easy fashion.
  • Basic understanding of KPIs and Metrics.
  • Attention to detail is key to this position.
  • Must be able to accommodate flexible work schedules based on business needs.
  • Must have technical/diagnostic ability along with analytical ability to diagnose problems above basics, and basic mechanical skills.
  • Understand how to use a web browser console log in the debugging process
  • Understanding of Public/Priviate IP addresses and Domain names
  • Understanding what a Firewall does
  • What does a Proxy Server do
  • Understanding of the basics of SSO


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

Your role is simple:

Share Refer with people who qualify

title: Customer Support & Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
Position Summary

We are looking for a Customer Support & Revenue Operations Specialist to join a fast-growing real estate startup in the U.S. This is a hybrid role that combines helpdesk support, HubSpot operations, outbound sales assistance, and light marketing support.

The ideal candidate has strong experience managing support tickets, excellent communication skills, deep familiarity with HubSpot, and the ability to multitask across customer support, RevOps, and sales processes in a fast-paced startup environment.


Key Responsibilities

Customer Support & Helpdesk (40–50%)

  • Serve as the primary responder for inbound support tickets from users.
  • Monitor, triage, and resolve issues through HubSpot Service Hub.
  • Maintain strong response/resolution times with empathetic, professional communication.
  • Document common issues and build internal resources or playbooks.


HubSpot Operations & Administration (20–25%)

  • Manage and optimize workflows, pipelines, automations, and ticket management across HubSpot.
  • Maintain data accuracy for contacts, deals, and support tickets.
  • Support setup and QA of new sequences, processes, and automation in HubSpot.
  • Pull basic reports on sales activity, ticket volume, and marketing performance.


Outbound Sales & Appointment Setting (20–25%)

  • Execute outbound email campaigns and sequences targeting prospects such as real estate agents or brokers.
  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads following defined playbooks.
  • Set calls and demos for the sales team.
  • Track all activities and updates inside HubSpot.


Marketing Support (5–10%)

  • Assist with email marketing campaigns, list building, and segmentation.
  • Support basic digital marketing tasks as needed.


Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of customer support or helpdesk experience (B2B SaaS experience preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot, including:
  • Service/Operations Hub (tickets, workflows, automation)
  • Sales Hub (pipelines, deals, sequences, tasks)
  • Proven success managing support tickets as a core responsibility.
  • Experience supporting outbound sales workflows, sequences, and appointment setting.
  • Familiarity with email marketing or digital campaign support.
  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with shifting demands.
  • Availability to work 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM MST .


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in real estate or PropTech industries.
  • Familiarity with Google Workspace, ClickUp, and Canva.
  • Experience building support documentation, macros, or knowledge base articles.
  • Track record of improving support metrics or boosting outbound meeting conversions.


What We Offer

  • Fully Remote Position! Work from anywhere in the world.
  • Professional Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and skill development.
  • Take Your Local Holidays: We respect your cultural and personal commitments.
  • Impact: Join a mission-driven U.S. startup where your work directly enhances customer experience and revenue operations.
  • Compensation: Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.

Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA


Certificações:

Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

REMOTO

title: Regulatory Research Analyst
description:
Job Title: Regulatory Research Analyst

Location: Brazil

Work Mode: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Independent Contractor (hourly pay, no benefits, and you’re responsible for your own taxes)

Contract Duration: 6 months (with possibility of extension)

Hours: 40 hours per week


Overview

We are seeking an experienced Regulatory Research Analyst to join the Tax & Regulations team of a global independent support provider. This fully remote role focuses on researching and tracking global trade regulations —primarily across LATAM and North America—and contributing insights that help keep SAP GTS systems up to date for global clients. The analyst will act as the first point of contact for new legal and regulatory changes and work closely with Business Analysts and ERP/GTS specialists. Client interaction is minimal; the role is primarily research-oriented.


Key Responsibilities

Regulatory Research & Analysis

  • Monitor and maintain up-to-date awareness of legislative and regulatory changes in assigned countries using government websites, agencies, third-party sources, and in-country experts.
  • Track global trade compliance regulations, including customs duties, export controls, sanctions, tariff updates , and other relevant requirements across jurisdictions (U.S., Canada, LATAM, etc.).
  • Interpret, analyze, and document new or amended legislation in an internal repository with high accuracy and clarity.
  • Prepare comparative analyses of regulatory changes when required.
  • Ensure research and documentation meet ISO process standards .

SAP GTS Alignment

Research and provide insights relevant to SAP GTS (v11 or similar), supporting product specialists on topics such as:

  • Export Control & Licensing
  • Import Control & Market Access
  • Sanctions & Restricted Party Compliance
  • Customs & Tariff Management
  • Trade Agreements & Origin Management
  • Regulatory Reporting & Declarations
  • Product & Classification Compliance

Collaboration & Documentation

  • Deliver clear summaries and detailed regulatory insights needed by ERP and product specialists to implement system changes for clients.
  • Collaborate with Business Analysts and fellow researchers to validate findings and maintain consistency.
  • Support research expansion into Indirect Tax topics (VAT, GST, country-specific filing requirements) where applicable.


Must-Have Qualifications

  • Bilingual: English + one LATAM language (Spanish or Portuguese) .
  • 5+ years of professional experience in tax, global trade, or international regulatory research.
  • Working knowledge of SAP GTS or similar trade compliance systems.
  • Familiarity with international trade laws and frameworks (EAR, ITAR, EU Dual Use, WCO, etc.).
  • Strong research, analytical, and documentation skills with excellent attention to detail.


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and handle multiple tasks under pressure.
  • Strong internet-based research capabilities and proficiency in business applications (Microsoft Office, Google tools, SharePoint, etc.).
  • Experience compiling complex regulatory information into clear, actionable summaries.
  • Technical understanding of SAP ERP tax/accounting workflows (advantageous, not mandatory).
  • Familiarity with tools like Excel, PDF generation, ABBYY FineReader, Deepl, Inoreader, Beyond Compare (training provided).
  • Self-starter with strong initiative, resourcefulness, and team-oriented mindset.
  • Additional background in finance or tax is a plus.


Why Join Us?

  • Work remotely while contributing to high-impact global compliance research.
  • Collaborate with a diverse international team of trade and tax experts.
  • Play a key role in helping global clients stay compliant with rapidly evolving regulations.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Job Title: Data Engineer

Location: Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: Full Time

Compensation: Competitive hourly rate, commensurate with experience



About Design Manager

Design Manager (+DesignSpec) is a leading provider of project management and accounting software tailored specifically for interior design firms. For over 30 years, we’ve helped thousands of designers run more efficient, profitable businesses with our cloud-based platform that integrates purchasing, budgeting, time tracking, and client communication in one seamless solution. As we grow, we're investing heavily in our data infrastructure to enhance product capabilities and improve client outcomes.



About the Role


We’re seeking a skilled Data Engineer to support our product and technology team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for building and maintaining data pipelines, analyzing data, and enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization. You'll be the first and only dedicated data analytics team member , so we’re looking for someone with an entrepreneurial mindset who is comfortable operating independently, defining structure, and solving complex data challenges.



What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL processes


  • Clean, validate, and structure raw data from various sources to ensure data quality and usability


  • Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights that support business decision-making


  • Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations to communicate key performance metrics to stakeholders


  • Work cross-functionally with teams (e.g., finance, operations, marketing) to define data needs and solve business problems using data


  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand and meet data requirements


  • Develop data models and schemas for analytics and reporting


  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data pipelines for performance and reliability


  • Support the design and implementation of a modern data warehouse architecture


  • Ensure data quality, governance, and security best practices are followed


  • Work with third-party APIs and internal tools to extract, transform, and load data


  • Demonstrate an entrepreneurial, self-starter attitude as the inaugural data analytics hire




Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in data engineering or a related field


  • Proficiency in SQL and experience with Python or another scripting language


  • Experience analyzing large datasets and generating insights that drive business impact


  • Familiarity with dashboarding and analytics platforms such as Mode, Power BI, or similar


  • Hands-on experience with modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift)


  • Experience with ETL tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt, Fivetran) and data pipeline orchestration


  • Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts and data modeling


  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills


  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with minimal oversight




Nice to Have


  • Experience in SaaS or B2B software environments


  • Exposure to finance or accounting domains




Why Join Us

  • Competitive hourly compensation


  • High-impact role with significant autonomy and visibility


  • Opportunity to shape the foundation of data and analytics at a growing SaaS company


  • Collaborative and mission-driven team environment


  • Possibility for contract extension or full-time conversion based on performance and business needs

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineers


Breakthrough Talent is currently supporting a leading data business build a brand new data platform to support a modern data mesh organisation. They work with national and global clients across data, software and digital consulting, and they are now looking for a Data Infrastructure Engineer to help build and scale their next generation platform.


This role suits someone who enjoys owning infrastructure, building reusable solutions, and supporting data teams with analytics and AI ready environments.


The Role


As a Data Engineer you will design, build and maintain the core infrastructure that enables data processing, analytics, data science and data management across the business.


You will work in a multi account and multi region AWS environment that follows zero trust and least privilege principles. Infrastructure as Code and CI CD will be central to how you operate, alongside continuous improvement and strong governance.


What You Will Do


  • Build and maintain cloud based infrastructure using Cloud Formation and SAM
  • Design and implement data processing environments using AWS services such as Glue, EMR, Sagemaker, Redshift, Aurora and Snowflake
  • Build data processing pipelines using Python, SQL, PySpark, Spark, Lambda, Step Functions and Apache Airflow
  • Monitor performance, cost and security of the data platform
  • Apply strong data governance and access control for sensitive data
  • Collaborate with multiple teams to support the wider data platform strategy


What You Need


  • Six years or more experience in a Data Engineering or Data Infrastructure role
  • Strong experience building data architectures in AWS
  • Solid coding skills in Python and SQL, Golang
  • Strong Cloud Formation knowledge
  • Experience working with relational databases such as Postgres or Redshift
  • Good coding discipline including documentation, unit testing and version control
  • Experience with Git and CI CD tools such as GitLab
  • Worked in Agile teams and ceremonies
  • Strong problem solving skills and excellent communication


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Jira or similar project management tools
  • Experience with Snowflake
  • Spatial data processing experience


If you would like to learn more about the role, please reach out to Jake Denman at Breakthrough Talent.

description:
Remote Human Resources and Investigation ASSISTANT and Human Resources and Investigation SPECIALIST Positions (Effective 8/01/25)


  • Do you live in BRAZIL  and have advanced professional communication skills in English, both orally and in writing? 
  • Do you love to read, write, and analyze things?

  • Would you describe yourself as someone who has a strong eye for detail? 
  • Do you have experience working independently and managing your time effectively in a home office setting? 
  • Are you a curious person with an analytical mind who gets excited about the pursuit of solving a mystery in the context of employee discrimination/harassment complaint investigations? 
  • Are you someone who thrives in environments that offer continuous change, challenge, learning, and growth opportunities? 


If you answered YES to all the above questions, this may be the perfect opportunity for you to join our amazing team!  


About California Labor Solutions

California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA. CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search/recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California. We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations.


What are Workplace (Employee Complaint) Investigations?

In the U.S., when an employee files a complaint about harassment, discrimination, or retaliation, the organization is legally obligated to investigate it. Some are handled internally, and others require an external investigator to ensure impartiality… that’s where CLS comes in! Assistants support the Investigator during the investigation process, including interviews with the employee who filed the complaint, relevant witnesses, and the accused, taking interview notes, and gathering the evidence. Then, we analyze all the testimonies and evidence and reach a factual finding of whether the alleged conduct happened and, if so, whether it violated any of the company’s policies. 

Regardless of what you studied in a university or the type and duration of your work experience, this is a rare opportunity for you to build your career from step 1 in a Junior or Assistant position. You are expected to learn the job quickly to become competent in the work that we do, and promote to the next position, usually after only 12 months of learning the entire investigation process.  


We are hiring for either an HR & Investigation Assistant OR an HR & Investigation Specialist.


Amazing Compensation, Benefits, and Bonuses:

Compensation:


HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION ASSISTANT (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $4,200 BRL to $7,000 BRL. This includes benefits which are:

·      Gym membership support: $105 BRL

·      Private health insurance support: $265 BRL

·      Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL


Starting monthly base compensation depends on the level and quality of your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs AND possession of both required and preferred qualifications. Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.  

The HR & Investigation Assistant position may become eligible for promotion to the HR & Investigation Specialist position after a minimum of 12 months, during which time advanced core competencies required to perform the work are established. 


HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SPECIALIST (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $7,000 BRL - $11,000 BRL.

The total compensation amount includes benefits which are:

·      Gym membership support: $105 BRL

·      Private health insurance support: $265 BRL

·      Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL


Starting total monthly compensation will be between $7,000 BRL to $9,000 BRL depending on your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs, possession of both required and preferred qualifications and your performance on the assessments in the hiring process.

Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position. 


Additional Compensation & High-Performance Bonus Opportunities - Such as:


·      High-performance bonus: When you perform investigations work, every investigation that you complete from start to finish according to CLS protocols and without major errors, you will receive a bonus of $700 BRL. That is $700 BRL for the person assisting the investigator AND another $700 BRL for the senior writer (person co-leading the project and performing the final review.) When you become a “CLS Certified Investigator’s Assistant” (which is usually within the first 3 to 6 months of joining CLS), the bonus increases to $1,400 BRL per investigation.


Operations Schedule from Your Designated Home Office

Join an enthusiastic team and make a real difference in this full-time role. Core hours of operation are 6 am - 4 pm PST / 7 am - 5 pm PDT, California/USA, Monday - Friday, and the potential for extended hours or weekend contributions for high-impact projects.


Minimum Education/Experience Requirements   

Human Resources & Investigation ASSISTANT:   

  • Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.  
  • A minimum of 2 years of full-time professional work experience in English (in any field) is required.  (Work experience in an internship does not count towards the 2-year requirement). 
  • A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is required.  
  • A Professional Bachelor’s Degree in any field is required.  
  • Experience drafting employee disciplinary letters and conducting investigations of workplace issues is preferred.  
  • 3 or more years of experience working in a full-time professional HR-related job in English, which includes daily communication and writing using advanced professional English skills, is preferred.   

Human Resources & Investigation SPECIALIST:   

  • Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.  
  • At least 5 years of full-time professional work experience in English is required . Internships do not count. At least 3 of those 5 years must be in full-time HR positions where you frequently wrote professional documents in English. 
  • A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is required.  
  • Experience supervising 3 or more employees for at least 1 year is required.   
  • Experience drafting employee disciplinary letters and conducting investigations of workplace issues is preferred.  
  • A Professional Bachelor’s Degree in any field is required.  A Master's Degree is preferred.  


GROW at CLS! PROMOTIONAL POSITIONS ONLY for CURRENT CLS TEAM MEMBERS:


HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SUPERVISOR (Promotional only): The total monthly compensation range is $9,800 BRL to $16,800 BRL (this includes benefits). You will receive a performance evaluation and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL every 6 months. The amount of your compensation increase depends on your performance and will continue to increase every 6-months until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.

HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION MANAGER (Promotional only): The total monthly compensation range is $16,800 BRL to $27,000 BRL (this includes benefits). title: Consultor(a) Comercial
description:

Quem somos e o que fazemos: Nossa missão é impactar vidas positivamente, conectando pessoas ao emprego ideal e ajudando empresas a crescerem com os melhores talentos. Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, dinâmico e focado no seu desenvolvimento, onde você se sentirá valorizado, realizado e orgulhoso de fazer parte da nossa equipe.


O que oferecemos:


  • Remuneração competitiva e benefícios atrativos;
  • Modelo de trabalho híbrido;
  • Foco no bem-estar e felicidade no trabalho;
  • Treinamentos de liderança e planos personalizados de desenvolvimento de carreira;
  • Investimento contínuo em inteligência artificial e tecnologia de ponta para apoiar seu sucesso;

  • Prospecção e relacionamento com clientes;
  • Acompanhamento de candidatos durante o processo de contratação;
  • Negociação contratual;
  • Mapeamento de mercado e análise de tendências;
  • Visitas a clientes para entender suas necessidades.


Quem procuramos: Buscamos profissionais apaixonados, éticos e orientados a resultados, com:

  • Curiosidade, pensamento crítico e capacidade de tomar decisões ágeis;
  • Habilidade para construir relacionamentos sólidos com clientes e candidatos;
  • Adaptabilidade e interesse em aprender novas tecnologias;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e interpessoais;
  • Graduação completa e experiência prévia na área comercial;
  • Inglês avançado.


Nosso compromisso com a diversidade: Na Robert Half, valorizamos a inclusão e a diversidade de pensamentos e perspectivas. Nosso objetivo é construir uma comunidade que reflita a pluralidade dos nossos clientes, promovendo igualdade e respeito às singularidades de cada indivíduo.


Faça parte da nossa história! Se você está pronto para impactar carreiras e crescer em uma empresa global, envie sua candidatura e venha transformar o futuro com a Robert Half.
