title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Hiring: Cloud Engineer (GCP / AWS / Python / AVID MAM)

Location: Remote / Hybrid (based on region)

Experience Level: Mid–Senior


About the Role


We are looking for a skilled Cloud Engineer with strong experience across Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AWS, Python development, and workflow migration. The ideal candidate will also have hands-on expertise with AVID Media Asset Management (MAM) systems and the ability to support modern CI/CD deployment practices.


This role involves cloud-based workflow modernization, application and media workflow migration, automation scripting, and integration across cloud environments.


Key Responsibilities


  • Design, implement, and support solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and AWS.
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts and integrations using Python.
  • Lead or support workflow migration initiatives from legacy systems to cloud-native architectures.
  • Work with AVID MAM systems for media workflow integration, configuration, and automation support.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support continuous deployment and operational excellence.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (engineering, media operations, DevOps) to design efficient and scalable solutions.
  • Troubleshoot cloud-based applications, media workflows, and infrastructure issues.


Required Skills & Experience


  • Strong hands-on expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Experience with AWS services, cloud deployment models, and cross-cloud integration.
  • Proficiency in Python for automation, scripting, data processing, or workflow integration.
  • Proven experience in workflow migration (media workflows preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, etc.).
  • AVID MAM (Avid Media Asset Management) experience is mandatory.
  • Ability to troubleshoot, optimize, and document cloud and media workflows.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in a distributed team.


Nice to Have


  • Experience with media workflows, broadcast systems, or video delivery platforms.
  • Knowledge of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with storage, CDN, streaming, or metadata management in cloud environments.

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking a DevOps / Technical Support Engineer to support a development team working on the internationalization and maintenance of a large-scale e-commerce platform. The environment consists of a distributed microservices architecture deployed on on-premises Kubernetes clusters and virtual machines , requiring hands-on troubleshooting, deployment operations, and strong coordination with engineering teams and clients. This role is highly technical and involves active participation in English-speaking client meetings and collaboration across multiple teams.


Responsibilities

  • Support the development team responsible for translating and adapting a distributed microservices e-commerce platform.
  • Manage and troubleshoot Kubernetes microservice deployments using Helm charts.
  • Operate and maintain Jenkins CI/CD pipelines; diagnose and resolve failures in automated deployment processes.
  • Collaborate closely with Java and Python development teams to understand deployment requirements.
  • Troubleshoot client ecosystem tools based on Jenkins self-service pipelines.
  • Support backend technologies such as PostgreSQL and Kafka, handling configuration, connectivity, and integration issues.
  • Retrieve and analyze logs from Kubernetes pods and on-prem VMs using Grafana, ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), and Jenkins logs.
  • Participate in English-speaking client meetings to gather requirements, clarify needs, and provide updates.
  • Manage work using a Kanban workflow.
  • Contribute to improvements in deployment processes, documentation, monitoring, and troubleshooting procedures.


Required Qualifications

  • Experience with Kubernetes, Helm, and containerized deployments in on-premise environments.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, especially Jenkins.
  • Basic to intermediate experience with microservices written in Java and Python.
  • Familiarity with PostgreSQL and Kafka.
  • Ability to diagnose distributed system issues using logs, dashboards, and monitoring tools (Grafana, ELK, etc.).
  • Experience with on-premises infrastructure.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to participate confidently in English-speaking client meetings.
  • Experience with Agile/Kanban methodologies.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in complex environments.
  • Proven experience troubleshooting legacy systems built in Java.


Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with large enterprise e-commerce platforms.
  • Knowledge of networking, authentication, and authorization concepts.
  • Familiarity with scripting languages such as Bash or Python.
  • Experience with Groovy for Jenkins Pipeline-as-Code.

title: Creative Production Lead
description:
Given that this position requires English proficiency, we are only considering CV's provided in English. Thank you, and we look forward to your submission!

﻿

About Olly Olly

Ready to roll up your sleeves and help transform local marketing forever? At Olly Olly, we're blending technology and real-world expertise to empower small businesses across the U.S. like never before.


We believe small businesses are the backbone of our economy. That's why we're on a mission to provide them with tools, strategies, and insights that help them rank higher, generate high-quality leads, get calls and reviews, and grow sustainably without the hassle.


The Olly Olly platform complements our hands-on service perfectly: it's no-nonsense, easy-to-use software that helps local businesses streamline operations, drive leads, and maximize revenue with minimal effort so they can focus on what they do best.


Why We Need You

You have the eye. You can look at a website for five seconds and know whether it builds trust or destroys it. You see the logo that looks like a 2008 Fiverr special, the stock photo that screams "we didn't try," the typography that signals cheap. And it bothers you. Physically.


We're building a production team that creates websites, logos, and visual assets for 4,000+ local service businesses—contractors, plumbers, attorneys, HVAC companies. These businesses live or die by how professional they look online. Your job is to make sure everything we ship makes them look like the best option in their market.


As Creative Production Lead , you'll manage a team of designers who assemble websites from content, photos, and structured data. You're not just assigning tickets. You're inspecting work daily, catching the details that kill credibility, coaching your team to see what you see, and refusing to let "good enough" out the door.


You can also DO the work yourself. When a logo needs to be created or fixed, you're not waiting for someone else. When a layout isn't working, you can open the file and make it better. You lead by example because you're a designer first, manager second.


The Impact You'll Have

  • Quality is your obsession. You review completed work daily—not for completion, but for excellence. You catch the weak logo, the amateur photo crop, the layout that buries the CTA, the color palette that feels dated. Nothing ships unless it meets your standards.
  • You inspect, you coach, you elevate. You're providing specific feedback on real work: "This logo doesn't work because the type is fighting the icon." "This hero image undermines trust—the lighting looks fake." "This layout guides the eye away from what matters." You're building your team's taste through detailed critiques.
  • You stay fluid. What looked great two years ago looks tired today. You're constantly studying what's working across industries, updating standards, killing approaches that stopped converting. When you spot a pattern that works, you train the team on it immediately.
  • You execute when needed. Logo needs a refresh? You can do it. Layout falling apart? You fix it. You're not above the work—you're the best at it.
  • You run production, not a gallery. This is high-volume. Your team handles hundreds of sites and thousands of updates monthly. You understand that speed and quality aren't opposites—they require discipline, systems, and people who give a damn.


What We Really Need From You

Core Requirements

  • 5+ years in visual design with a portfolio that demonstrates genuine taste—not just competence, but an eye for what converts vs. what just exists
  • 2+ years leading or managing a design team—you've held people to standards, given hard feedback, and developed talent
  • Hands-on execution skills: you can create and refine logos, fix layouts, improve visual hierarchy yourself
  • Production experience: you've worked in environments where volume mattered—agencies, e-commerce, high-output teams
  • Quality obsession: you reject work that's "fine" because fine doesn't win


What Would Be Big Pluses

  • Background in advertising, branding agencies, or e-commerce design
  • Experience with WordPress page builders (Elementor, WP Bakery, Divi, Gutenberg)—or willingness to learn fast
  • Understanding of conversion principles: what builds trust, what drives action
  • Experience building or maintaining design systems
  • Knowledge of SEO basics and how design choices impact performance


We'll teach you:

  • Our specific tools and workflows
  • WordPress/Elementor if you don't know them (you'll pick it up in a week)
  • Our brand guidelines and quality standards
  • The local service business landscape


What You'll Love About Working at Olly Olly

  • Salary: Competitive (based on experience and location)
  • Flexible work: 100% remote, core hours 8 AM – 5 PM EST for collaboration
  • Work-life balance: 15 vacation days + U.S. holidays
  • Growth path: This role leads to Director of Creative Production or VP of Creative. You'll build the team, the systems, and the culture.
  • Real impact: Your standards directly determine whether 17,000+ small businesses look like winners or also-rans.


Why Choose Us?

We're evolving from template-driven agency work to genuinely differentiated design. You'll build a team culture where craft matters, where mediocrity gets rejected, and where the work actually helps small businesses compete.


Diversity and Inclusion at Olly Olly

At Olly Olly, we celebrate differences in background, culture, abilities, and perspectives because diversity drives innovation and creativity. Your voice matters here—and your unique perspective helps us shape the future of small business growth.

title: Podcast Producer
description:
Podcast Producer (Full-Service Management) – Sofia Health


Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term Role


Sofia Health is looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Podcast Producer to manage the full production workflow of our weekly interview podcast, Sofia Unfiltered. This role handles guest communication, scheduling, episode preparation, editorial coordination, and project management from pre-production through publishing.


We interview physicians, psychologists, authors, wellness experts, and thought leaders. You must be able to communicate professionally, manage multiple moving pieces, and maintain a calm, supportive tone consistent with our brand.


⭐What You’ll Do (Responsibilities) Guest Communication & Outreach
  • Manage all communication with guests from initial outreach to post-episode follow-up
  • Schedule interviews, send confirmations/reminders, and provide prep materials
  • Collect bios, headshots, books, links, and required release forms
  • Draft guest outreach emails and pitch new guests aligned with upcoming content themes
  • Maintain guest pipeline, schedules, and assets in Notion/Google Drive


Episode Planning & Production
  • Prepare episode briefs and host prep sheets
  • Attend live recordings (optional but preferred) to track timestamps and notes
  • Review raw audio/video and provide clear, detailed edit notes to the editor
  • Restructure episodes when needed for clarity, flow, and narrative arc
  • Collaborate on episode titles, angles, hooks, and story direction
  • Choose main promotional clips and quotes for social content


Editing Coordination
  • Send the editor cut notes that are clear, accurate, and time-stamped
  • Review first edit, request revisions, and ensure quality before publishing
  • Ensure the final episode reflects brand voice, pacing, clarity, and guest experience


Publishing & Show Management
  • Write compelling show notes, descriptions, summaries, and timestamps
  • Prepare publishing assets (titles, tags, categories, episode artwork if needed)
  • Upload weekly episodes to our hosting platform (Spotify for Podcasters or similar)
  • Track episode performance metrics and maintain publishing calendar


Marketing & Promotion Support
  • Coordinate with the social media team to deliver clips, quotes, and captions
  • Identify promotional opportunities through guests’ audiences
  • Support the creation of audiograms, reels, and short-form content briefs


Monetization & Growth
  • Assist in creating sponsorship decks and packages
  • Research relevant brand partners to pitch
  • Coordinate guest cross-promotion to increase downloads
  • Identify podcast swaps and collaboration opportunities
  • Track growth trends and propose strategies to expand reach


Host & Media Outreach (Podcast Guest Booking)


  • Research aligned podcasts across wellness, entrepreneurship, marketing, leadership, mental health, women’s health, lifestyle medicine, and business growth
  • Create a list of high-quality podcasts suitable for Riley as a guest
  • Draft personalized podcast pitches in Riley’s voice
  • Send and manage outreach emails to podcast hosts and producers
  • Track outreach, follow-ups, and confirmed appearances in Notion or a CRM
  • Coordinate scheduling, prep materials, and talking points
  • Prepare Riley with a one-sheet, interview brief, and relevant episodes of the host
  • Identify opportunities for backlinks, newsletter swaps, and co-marketing
  • Track results and optimize pitches based on acceptance rates



You’re a Great Fit If You…


  • Have real podcast producing experience (required—not entry-level)
  • Have excellent written English and can write in a warm, professional tone
  • Are organized and reliable with strong project management skills
  • Love structure, systems, checklists, and keeping details tight
  • Can communicate confidently with high-profile guests
  • Can listen to an episode and identify what needs to be cut for clarity and flow
  • Are comfortable giving editors detailed, accurate instructions
  • Enjoy managing timelines, assets, and follow-ups
  • Can work independently and solve problems proactively
  • Are calm under pressure and able to meet weekly deadlines


⭐ Required Skills & Experience
  • 2+ years experience as a Podcast Producer , Podcast Manager , or similar
  • Experience working with audio/video editors
  • Strong writing and communication skills
  • Ability to review episodes and give editorial direction
  • Experience managing guests and scheduling interviews
  • Familiarity with publishing platforms (Spotify for Podcasters, Buzzsprout, etc.)
  • Strong organizational skills with tools like Notion, Trello, Asana, or Airtable
  • Comfortable coordinating social media assets
  • Ability to work in US time zones when needed


Bonus:

  • Experience with sponsorship outreach or monetization
  • Background in wellness, psychology, health, or coaching content
  • Experience producing long-form interview-style shows
  • Ability to identify clips for short-form video

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
About the Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced a DevOps Engineer to support the transition of a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) backend system from a Proof of Concept (PoC) to a scalable, production-ready platform.

This role will focus on building, configuring, and deploying a serverless architecture leveraging AWS Bedrock, Lambda, API Gateway, RDS PostgreSQL, and other managed services.

You will collaborate closely with RedTeam’s existing .NET backend team to integrate a new Backend RAG API Service , enabling semantic search on construction specification documents through existing frontend applications.


Responsibilities

Infrastructure Provisioning

  • Execute curated deployment scripts using the AWS SDK.
  • Provision the full serverless architecture: API Gateway, Lambda, RDS (PostgreSQL), VPC components, and Bedrock Knowledge Base .

API Gateway Configuration

  • Deploy and configure RESTful API endpoints for chat query orchestration.
  • Ensure correct integration with the customer’s .NET API, where authentication/authorization is handled (no native AWS auth).

AWS Lambda Deployment

  • Deploy the API Orchestrator Lambda and the Ingestion & KB Sync Lambda functions.
  • Ensure Lambdas run inside the VPC and can be invoked by the customer’s .NET backend.

Networking & Security

  • Configure VPC networking, subnets, and access control for RDS connections.
  • Implement pragmatic least-privilege IAM policies for all components.

S3 Integration Setup

  • Configure Amazon S3 as the corpus data source for the AWS Bedrock Knowledge Base.
  • Enable automatic synchronization between the S3 bucket and the Knowledge Base.

Database Deployment

  • Deploy and configure the Amazon RDS PostgreSQL instance for chat history and conversation memory.
  • Execute necessary DDL changes and schema configuration.

Observability Setup

  • Configure CloudWatch logs and alarms for monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational health.


Required Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS Serverless Architecture (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB or RDS).
  • Experience provisioning AWS environments using AWS SDK, IaC scripts, or automated deployment pipelines .
  • Proficiency with VPC networking, IAM security policies , and integrating private Lambdas with RDS.
  • Knowledge of RDS (PostgreSQL) administration and schema deployment.
  • Experience with CloudWatch for logging, metrics, and alarm configuration.
  • Ability to integrate backend services with external APIs, especially .NET-based systems.


Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
  • Familiarity with AWS Bedrock , Bedrock Knowledge Base, and generative AI workloads.
  • Working knowledge of semantic search , embeddings, or vector-based search systems.
  • Experience with .NET backend integration or hybrid cloud/backend environments.
  • Exposure to infra-as-code tools (CloudFormation, CDK, Terraform).
  • Background in serverless best practices , scalability, and production hardening.

É uma vaga ideal para quem está no início da carreira em UX/UI, gosta de entender jornadas, organizar informação, desenhar telas e quer aprender diretamente com pessoas mais experientes, participando do ciclo completo de produto: discovery, definição, prototipação e handoff para desenvolvimento.

  • Apoiar na manutenção e evolução do design system , ajudando a manter consistência entre os diferentes produtos.
  • Buscar referências, boas práticas e exemplos de UX/UI para inspirar soluções melhores.


REQUISITOS:


Eliminatórios (OBRIGATÓRIO):

  • Experiência prévia em UX/UI (pode ser estágio, projetos acadêmicos, freelas ou autorais) com portfólio que mostre seu raciocínio de design.
  • Conhecimento básico/intermediário em Figma (ou ferramenta similar) para criação de wireframes, protótipos e interfaces.
  • Noções sólidas de fundamentos de UX : hierarquia de informação, usabilidade, navegação, feedback ao usuário.
  • Noções de UI e design visual : tipografia, espaçamento, alinhamento, contrastes, componentes.
  • Interesse real em trabalhar com produto digital B2B/SaaS (nada de “só layout bonito”: aqui a experiência tem impacto direto no negócio).
  • Vontade de aprender, ouvir feedback, iterar e trabalhar em equipe.
  • Capacidade de comunicar ideias de forma clara , tanto visualmente quanto falando/escrevendo.


HABILIDADES DESEJÁVEIS:


  • Experiência com testes de usabilidade (mesmo que simples, acadêmicos ou em projetos pessoais).
  • Noções de HTML/CSS (para entender melhor as limitações e possibilidades na hora de desenhar telas).
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de prototipação e handoff (Figma, FigJam, Zeplin, etc.).
  • Experiência ou interesse em produtos B2B SaaS, logística, e-commerce ou last-mile .

BENEFÍCIOS:


  • Remuneração competitiva + participação nos resultados .
  • Plano de saúde (incluindo cônjuge e filhos).
  • Plano odontológico .
  • Seguro de vida .
  • Cartão de benefícios flexível .
  • Rotina com ferramentas modernas e IA ; aprendizado contínuo.
  • 100% remoto (trabalhe de qualquer lugar do Brasil).


DETALHES:


  • Modelo de contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) .
  • Jornada: tempo integral, com eventuais rituais/treinamentos.
  • Local: remoto – fuso BRT (GMT-3) .
  • Todas as vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PcD).
  • Em nossos processos seletivos, não há qualquer tipo de distinção em virtude de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, crença, condição social, etnia ou raça .


Como se destacar:

Ao se candidatar, envie seu portfólio , mesmo que com projetos acadêmicos ou pessoais, mostrando:

  • Processo , não só telas prontas: problema, contexto, alternativas que você considerou e por que escolheu a solução final.
  • Wireframes e fluxos : como você organiza a informação e constrói a navegação.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with either Golang, Node.js, or Java, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Sondador
description:
Resumo da função:


Responsável por realizar operações de perfuração e/ou intervenções de poços (workover) operando sondas, sejam elas hidráulicas ou convencionais; liderar as equipes em diversas atividades, com ou sem sonda, tais como: atividades Rig up/Rig & down (montagem e desmontagem), despressurização de poços, slick line, pescaria, wireline, dentre outras, visando pela segurança operacional, ambiental e da equipe.


Responsabilidades:

  • Conhecer e interpretar os principais dados específicos do poço (profundidade, pressão da formação, densidade do fluido de amortecimento, MAASP, etc), diagrama proposto de equipagem e o diagrama anterior para iniciar/dar continuidade as intervenções do tipo workover
  • Executar as atividades de assentamento de packer: mecânico e hidráulico, corte de cimento e tampões mecânicos (BPP e BPR) obedecendo e tendo conhecimento dos parâmetros necessários como peso sobre broca e circulação
  • Garantir a correta execução de atividades de equipagem com conjunto BCS obedecendo os cuidados necessários com a elevação das cargas para não ocorrer a flambagem, obedecendo os cuidados necessários com o manuseio e operação do cabo BCS, spooler, conectores elétricos (pig tail), instalação de clamps e alinhamento do orifício do PTS do suspensor com o adaptador A3EC
  • Executar inspeções nos equipamentos de manobra (colar de segurança, cunhas manuais e hidráulicas, elevadores de tubo, chave hidráulica) e de elevação (eslingas e cabos) bem como garantir sua integridade antes do início das operações
  • Realizar o check list diário de inspeção do sondador e garantir o correto preenchimento/inspeção dos demais check lists (torrista e plataformista) pela sua equipe orientando os demais sempre que necessário
  • Operar a sonda conhecendo os principais riscos inerentes ao tipo e a capacidade da sonda – em sonda convencional deve garantir a correta execução da tonelada milha
  • Executar e garantir a execução de todos os aspectos de segurança exigidos em atividades em área classificada, trabalho em altura, movimentação de cargas, testes hidrostáticos, H2S, equipamentos rotativos e segurança de poço
  • Planejar de forma antecipada todos os materiais e ferramentas necessários para a intervenção, bem como garantir a integridade dos equipamentos e ferramentas a bordo comunicando ao supervisor qualquer dano ocorrido
  • Garantir que a equipe siga rigorosamente o programa do poço atendendo todos os parâmetros exigidos bem como as normas vigentes de segurança operacional e de equipamentos de ESCP
  • Saber pesquisar e ter em mãos tabelas de cimentação, tabelas hidráulicas, manuais de perfurações, tabelas de tubos e revestimentos, etc.
  • Controlar todos os parâmetros operacionais do workover: peso sobre broca, densidade e viscosidade do fluido, vazão e pressão de bombeio


Exigências do Cargo:

  • Disponibilidade - Amplitude de horário – Plantão noturno - Trabalho Offshore 14x14
  • Experiência como Sondador de sondas tipo HH Drillmec e ou convencional à cabo 250.000lbs(tipo double joint/mesa rotativa) comprovados em carteira de trabalho;
  • Experiência comprovada em assentamento de tampões mecânicos e hidráulicos e obturadores (packers);
  • Experiência em equipagem de poço com coluna BCS;
  • Conhecimento teórico e prático na atividade de perfuração e/ou completação;


Escolaridade mínima:


  • Ensino médio técnico completo


Qualificação A: antes do embarque:


  • Curso Básico de Segurança de Plataforma - CBSP
  • Treinamento de Escape de Aeronave Submersa - HEUT
  • Well Control IWCF – Level 3
  • Programa de Capacitação em Segurança e Saúde no Trabalho - NR37 - Básico

title: Product Owner - Consultor(a) Senior
description:

title: Senior AI Engineer (Python / Node.js)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software and AI/ML engineering experience. Candidates must have a strong background in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java expertise, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development : Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization
  • Back-End Integration : Build APIs, microservices, and orchestration frameworks that seamlessly connect AI models with enterprise systems and grid-level data flows
  • Pipeline Ownership : Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices.
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Analytical, collaborative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Ability to thrive in small, high-velocity teams, balancing experimentation with production rigor


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Data Scientist - Scheduling Optimization
description:
Job Description

About You

You are a data-driven professional passionate about solving complex scheduling and resource allocation challenges. You thrive on applying advanced optimization techniques to real-world problems, balancing mathematical rigor with practical feasibility. With strong analytical and modeling skills, you design solutions that improve efficiency, reduce costs, and ensure compliance with operational and regulatory requirements.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Advanced knowledge of optimization modeling (integer programming, constraint programming, heuristics/metaheuristics).
  • Proven experience developing and maintaining large-scale scheduling models in applied environments.
  • Ability to incorporate operational rules, contractual agreements, regulatory requirements, and business constraints into model formulations.
  • Hands-on experience with optimization solvers (e.g., Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools).
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Julia, or C++.
  • Strong understanding of data analysis for planning based on event calendars, service times, passenger volumes, and destination planning.
  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.


You will be accountable for the following responsabilities:

  • Develop and maintain advanced optimization models to solve large-scale scheduling problems.
  • Build models that consider event calendars, service times, passenger volumes, and destinations using available data.
  • Integrate operational rules, contractual obligations, regulatory requirements, and business constraints into model formulations.
  • Apply optimization solvers (Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools) to generate feasible, efficient schedules.
  • Collaborate with operations, planning, and technology teams to align outputs with real-world needs.
  • Analyze results to identify cost savings, efficiency improvements, and compliance risks.
  • Continuously refine models to adapt to changes in resource availability, demand patterns, and operational constraints.

title: Desenvolvimento web
description:
- PHP : Domínio da linguagem, incluindo orientação a objetos, padrões de projeto (design patterns) e integração com APIs.

- WordPress Core: Conhecimento da arquitetura do WordPress, incluindo a criação e personalização de temas e plugins do zero, uso de hooks, actions e filters.

- Frontend: Proficiência em HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+) e frameworks como React ou Vue.js (para componentes interativos).

- Banco de Dados: Experiência com MySQL, incluindo design de schemas, otimização de queries e gerenciamento de performance.

- WooCommerce: Experiência em customização de lojas virtuais, gateways de pagamento e regras de negócio complexas, se aplicável ao seu modelo.

- Análise de Vulnerabilidades: Capacidade de realizar auditorias de segurança, identificar e corrigir falhas comuns (XSS, CSRF, SQL Injection).

- Hardening de Servidor e WordPress: Implementação de melhores práticas de segurança, como configuração de firewalls (WAF), proteção contra brute-force e monitoramento de logs.

- Conformidade (LGPD/GDPR): Conhecimento técnico para adequar o site às leis de proteção de dados, incluindo gestão de consentimento de cookies, políticas de privacidade e mecanismos para exportação/exclusão de dados do usuário 1.

- Certificados SSL/TLS: Habilidade para instalar e gerenciar certificados de segurança.

- Core Web Vitals: Experiência comprovada na otimização dos indicadores do Google (LCP, FID, CLS) para melhorar a experiência do usuário e o ranking.

- Otimização de Performance: Técnicas de caching (servidor e navegador), minificação de CSS/JS, otimização de imagens (compressão e lazy loading) e uso de CDNs (Content Delivery Networks) 2. - SEO Técnico: Conhecimento em estruturação de URLs, criação de sitemaps XML, implementação de schema markup (dados estruturados), e otimização do arquivo robots.txt.

- Ferramentas de Análise: Domínio de ferramentas como Google PageSpeed Insights, GTmetrix e SEMrush para diagnóstico e monitoramento.

title: Diretor Escolar
description:
Este cargo estará localizado em uma escola no Brasil; não é remoto.


Com a expansão da International Schools Partnership pel, buscamos Diretores, Vice-diretores e Líderes Seniores com sólida experiência em educação K-12 e histórico comprovado de melhoria escolar. Procuramos líderes apaixonados pela Excelência Acadêmica , com visão operacional e mentalidade comercial para gerir escolas de alto desempenho.

Junte-se a uma rede global dedicada a fortalecer líderes escolares, promover inovação e transformar positivamente comunidades educacionais em toda a região.


Sobre a International Schools Partnership

A International Schools Partnership é um grupo global em crescimento, com 114 escolas internacionais privadas em 25 países, atendendo mais de 92.500 estudantes.

Nossa missão é apoiar nossas escolas para que se tornem a principal escolha em suas comunidades, estabelecendo novos padrões de qualidade, preparando estudantes para o futuro e contribuindo para o desenvolvimento das comunidades onde atuam.


Por que construir sua carreira na International Schools Partnership?

  • Visão Global: Atue em um ambiente que valoriza a perspectiva internacional e a diversidade cultural.
  • Compromisso com a Excelência: Faça parte de um grupo focado em ensino e aprendizagem de alta qualidade.
  • Ambientes Modernos: Trabalhe em instalações inovadoras e bem equipadas.
  • Desenvolvimento em Liderança: Tenha acesso a formação contínua e oportunidades de crescimento global.


Propósito do Cargo

O Diretor lidera com visão e integridade, construindo uma cultura escolar segura, inclusiva e colaborativa onde o aprendizado prospera. Em parceria com sua equipe, famílias e a rede International Schools Partnership, posiciona a escola como uma “Escola de Escolha”, garantindo experiências e resultados acadêmicos excepcionais, impulsionando matrículas e retenção. Suas responsabilidades incluem salvaguarda, melhoria do ensino baseada em evidências, planejamento estratégico, engajamento da comunidade e desempenho comercial.

O Diretor se reporta ao Diretor Regional (RMD).


Responsabilidades-Chave

(Com peso igual de 25% cada)

  • Desenvolvimento e bem-estar da equipe
  • Resultados de aprendizado dos estudantes
  • Engajamento comunitário e experiência das famílias
  • Desempenho comercial


Competências-Chave

Planejamento estratégico, liderança educacional, gestão de proteção infantil, liderança inclusiva, inteligência emocional, construção de comunidade, engajamento de stakeholders, desenvolvimento de equipes, gestão de desempenho, comunicação eficaz, tomada de decisão baseada em dados, marketing educacional, finanças, gestão de mudança e colaboração.


Compromisso com a Proteção Infantil

A International Schools Partnership está comprometida com a segurança e o bem-estar de crianças e jovens. Todos os profissionais devem cumprir processos rigorosos de verificação de antecedentes referentes aos últimos 10 anos de experiência.


Compromisso com Diversidade, Inclusão e Pertencimento

A International Schools Partnership promove uma cultura inclusiva e acolhedora, contratando e desenvolvendo talentos independentemente de gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, idade, deficiência, neurodivergência ou origem socioeconômica. Encorajamos candidaturas de profissionais que compartilham nossos valores e desejam contribuir para o sucesso da organização.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About You

You are a Senior Data Engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable data platforms and enabling data-driven and AI-powered products. You feel comfortable owning data pipelines end to end, working closely with analytics and AI/Data Science teams, and translating complex data problems into robust technical solutions.

You value clean architecture, performance, and data quality, and you’re curious about AI/ML integrations even if you’re not a model builder. You thrive in collaborative environments and can operate with autonomy while guiding best practices across teams.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field — or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, building and operating production-grade data pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL, including advanced joins, CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning.
  • Experience designing data models and analytical structures (dimensional models, facts, dimensions, SCDs).
  • Hands-on experience building ETL/ELT pipelines using modern orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, DBT, or similar).
  • Proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline development (PySpark is a strong plus).
  • Solid experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for data storage and processing.
  • Familiarity with data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, PostgreSQL, or similar.
  • Experience using Git and CI/CD practices as part of a modern data engineering workflow.
  • Exposure to supporting AI/Data Science initiatives, such as data enablement for models, embeddings, entity matching, or advanced analytics (nice to have).
  • Familiarity with graph databases, embeddings, or AI integrations from a data engineering perspective (nice to have).
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with analysts, ML engineers, and product teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2+), able to work with global stakeholders.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ingestion processes supporting analytics and AI use cases.
  • Implement and optimize ETL/ELT workflows with attention to performance, reliability, and cost.
  • Design and evolve data models and curated layers to support reporting, analytics, and downstream systems.
  • Collaborate with analytics, AI/Data Science, and product teams to understand data requirements and SLAs.
  • Support AI and advanced analytics features by providing clean, well-structured, and reliable datasets.
  • Apply best practices around data quality, validation, monitoring, and observability.
  • Write maintainable, well-documented data code and contribute to shared standards and patterns.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and help improve overall data platform design.
  • (If senior/lead-leaning) Support or mentor less-experienced data engineers as the team grows.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

title: Especialista em Lean
description:
Vaga disponível inclusive para Pessoas com Deficiência ou Reabilitados pelo INSS.



O Lean Specialist em Melhoria Contínua fornecerá liderança prática para implantar, implementar e impulsionar o Programa de Lean Manufacturing nas instalações de R&M.


Essa posição liderará a conversão para uma organização enxuta, conduzindo a implementação de ferramentas como:


  • Value Stream Management, Safety, 5S, TPM, Standard Work, Kanban/Pull Systems, Root-Cause Problem Solving, Quality at the Source, Lean Daily Management, SMED, POKE-YOKE, Just-in-time, cellular manufacturing, A3/PDCA Problem Solving.


Trabalhará em estreita colaboração com diversas áreas da planta, incluindo: Qualidade de Serviço, Armazenagem, Manutenção & Reparo, Compras, HSE, Finanças, Operações, RH e Qualidade.


Funções e Responsabilidades:


  • Garantir que segurança e qualidade sejam prioridades em todas as áreas do negócio.
  • Cumprir com os mais altos padrões de governança corporativa, respeitando políticas, procedimentos, leis e regulamentações aplicáveis.
  • Conhecer e aplicar a Política de Qualidade da Weatherford, cumprindo os requisitos do Quality Systems Manual (QSM) e demais procedimentos.
  • Coordenar a implantação do Programa de Lean Manufacturing junto ao gerente de R&M e equipe de liderança da planta.
  • Desenvolver e implementar Value Stream Mapping (VSM), com planos de ação de melhoria contínua.
  • Criar e sustentar processos padronizados em toda a organização.
  • Implementar Shop Daily Management (SDM).
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria em colaboração com gestores, supervisores, equipes e clientes, conduzindo projetos de produtividade, redução de desperdícios, eventos Kaizen e outras iniciativas de melhoria contínua.
  • Facilitar a gestão diária Lean e promover a cultura Lean por meio de Gemba Walk, iniciativas de segurança, 5S e gestão visual.

description:
Código da vaga: 55675

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

  • Ei Profissional Back End .Net/Aws - SR , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq

- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

- O que você deve ter?

Habilidades Principais:

  • Profissional com experiência em desenvolvimento back-end .Net com sólida vivência em ambientes escaláveis (milhões de transações/requisições mensais) e arquitetura baseada em microsserviços e mensageria (RabbitMQ ou Kafka).
  • Principais responsabilidades: Projetar, implementar e manter soluções distribuídas; desenvolver integrações assíncronas; otimizar infraestrutura em AWS (EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, etc.); e garantir performance, segurança e resiliência em sistemas de alta disponibilidade.
  • Requisitos obrigatórios: Experiência prática com AWS, RabbitMQ (ou mensageria similar), arquitetura de microsserviços, bancos relacionais (SQL Server, MySQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB). Desejável experiência com CI/CD, Git e metodologias ágeis.
  • Diferenciais: Certificações AWS, conhecimento em containers (Docker, Kubernetes), vivência com outras clouds (Azure, GCP) e experiência comprovada com sistemas de alta performance e escalabilidade.
  • Modelo de trabalho:Vaga presencial na região de Botafogo – RJ.

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Atuação híbrida; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

description:
The Development (Fundraiser) Officer will be responsible for mapping and applying for the possible grants and sponsorships from government laws, planning, organizing, and executing fundraising initiatives to support the mission and strategic goals of EARJ. This role requires a strong communicator with experience in data keeping and administration as well as event planning . The Officer will also work closely with the school leadership to implement effective development campaigns, foster a culture of giving, and increase community engagement.

Responsibilities:

title: Operations Manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.

Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.

Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.

Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

Operational Leadership

  • Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
  • Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
  • IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become "super-users" of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
  • Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
  • Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
  • Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
  • Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum's capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum's strengths in client meetings to support business development.
  • Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
  • CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
  • Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.

Team Development

  • Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
  • Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.

Compliance & QHSE

  • Process Optimisation: Act as a "process expert" within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
  • Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.

Commercial

  • Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
  • Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.

Team Culture and Engagement

  • Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
  • Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.

Client Account Management

  • Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
  • Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
  • Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.

Coordination Responsibilities

  • Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
  • Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
  • Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
  • Proficient in MS Office; CRM experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking.
  • Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary.

Additional Information:

This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum's coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth.

Travel

Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region.

HSE Awareness:

All personnel are informed of Fulkrum's Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations.

Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you'll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.

We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.

Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.

Apply now and become a valued part of our growing team!

Fulkrum

title: Especialista De Controladoria
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.
A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.
Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.
E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.
Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Experiência em metodologias ágeis e tradicionais de desenvolvimento.

Conhecimento em Arquitetura de TI e Integração de Sistemas.
Pós-graduação na área de Tecnologia.

title: Líder de vendas
description:
Objetivo e Relevância Global para a Organização:
Contribuir para o alcance das metas de KPI da Loja, proporcionando uma experiência memorável para os consumidores e praticando os Valores da Marca.   • Colaborar na obtenção dos KPIs da loja e garantir que a equipe tenha ciência deles e da forma como contribuem, e sugerir ajustes necessários para aumentar a produtividade e a eficiência no atendimento e na área de vendas.

  • Compreensão dos padrões de Visual Merchandising para impulsionar a conversão através de ações estratégicas.

title: Analista de Automação de Processos (RPA) Pleno
description:
Quem é Stone Tech?
A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.
Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton, Vitta e Collact, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.
Nossa cultura:
Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:
Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.
Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.
No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.
Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.
The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.
Modelo de trabalho da vaga:
Híbrido (RJ ou SP)
Como é ser uma pessoa Desenvolvedor de Automação de Processos (RPA):
Você irá desenvolver automação e otimização de processos operacionais na Stone. Sua missão começa por entender profundamente o estado atual ("AS IS") dos processos para, então, desenvolver o TO BE e implementar automações que visem ganho de eficiência, redução de custos e mitigação de riscos. Para atingir esses objetivos, você utilizará tanto ferramentas de código como Python e SQL quanto plataformas no/low-code UIPATH e Botcity e IA. Além disso, você será responsável por em projetos de melhoria contínua nas automações já existentes, o que inclui a realização de integrações com APIs REST. Por fim, você deverá criar e manter a documentação dos processos e códigos (PDD, UAT e SDD), seguindo as boas práticas de governança (Github, CI/CD), e contribuir para a elaboração de relatórios analíticos e dashboards sobre os indicadores operacionais.
O que esperamos de você:
Ser uma pessoa crítica e questionadora. Olhar para um processo existente sempre buscar automatizar e reduzir a necessidade de trabalho manual repetitivo, você terá espaço para isso. Porém, nos casos em que não for possível automatizar, não ter medo de botar a mão na massa e atuar na execução propriamente dita dos processos com diligência, disciplina e eficiência, garantindo a sustentação do negócio;
Conhecimento aplicado de ferramentas de programação Python e Botcity principalmente e ferramentas de automações tela a tela como UIPATH.
Bom relacionamento interpessoal e comunicação com stakeholders internos e externos.
Espírito de dono.
Perfil analítico. Fazer diagnósticos de causas dos problemas de forma proativa, medindo o impacto de cada uma delas no resultado do negócio, além de contribuir para construção de análises mais robustas junto aos times de dados do CSC;
Hands On, sem medo de resolver problemas e ter que executar processos operacionais;
Capacidade de ir a fundo em cada detalhe dos processos, entendendo todos os sistemas e micro etapas envolvidas.
O que aumentam suas chances:
Experiência prática em RPA utilizando Python, Botcity e UIPATH
Experiência com engenharia de Prompt/uso de IA para automação de tarefas
Nossos benefícios:

Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!
Entrevistas com o time de People: Este é o momento de nos conhecermos! Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.
Avaliação Técnica: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills! Geralmente essa avaliação é composta por dois papos ou um papo mais o desafio, com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências técnicas específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.
Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.
Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.
E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerStone
Aqui na Stone Co., valorizamos e procuramos as melhores pessoas para nos ajudar a melhorar a vida das pessoas empreendedoras do Brasil. Nosso sonho é do tamanho do universo e, se você se identifica com o nosso propósito, venha construí-lo com a gente! Caso queira saber mais:

title: Development (Fundraiser) Officer
description:
The Development (Fundraiser) Officer will be responsible for mapping and applying for the possible grants and sponsorships from government laws, planning, organizing, and executing fundraising initiatives to support the mission and strategic goals of EARJ. This role requires a strong communicator with experience in data keeping and administration as well as event planning. The Officer will also work closely with the school leadership to implement effective development campaigns, foster a culture of giving, and increase community engagement.
Responsibilities:
Fundraising Strategy: Assist in developing and implementing a comprehensive annual fundraising plan to meet the school's financial and development goals.
Campaigns & Events: Organize and coordinate fundraising events, campaigns, and initiatives, such as capital campaigns, online giving drives, auction evenings, and alumni engagement events.
Donor Relations: Cultivate and maintain relationships with potential and current donors, sponsors, and partners. Develop and implement donor recognition programs.
Research, identify, and apply for grants and sponsorship opportunities that align with the school's mission (Ex: "Lei de incentivo ao esporte").
Alumni Engagement: Work with alumni to foster lifelong connections to the school and to encourage giving.
Marketing & Communications: Collaborate with the marketing team to create compelling fundraising content, including newsletters, social media posts, and donor appeals.
Reporting & Data Management: Maintain accurate records of fundraising activities, donor contributions, and financial reports. Provide regular updates on fundraising progress to leadership.
Budget Management: Track and manage the fundraising budget, ensuring cost-effective planning and execution of events and initiatives.
Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Business, or a related field.
English fluency is essential for this position, as communication with international stakeholders will be a core part of the role.
Between 1 and 3 years of experience.
*Best to have experience in fundraising, development, or a similar role, preferably in an educational or nonprofit environment. Ideally this person would understand the Brazilian Government bureaucracy regarding "Leis de incentivo"

Desde a chegada da primeira embarcação do Grupo Chouest, em 1991, a frota em operação no Brasil vem aumentando, já contando com mais de 70 embarcações altamente especializadas, de última geração.

title: Computational Scientist
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world's largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.
Job Duties
We seek a talented Computational Scientist with an M.Sc. in Computational Science or Engineering and academic and/or professional experience. A Ph.D. degree with a strong background in Computational Science is a plus. The ideal candidate for this position is an expert in porting complex scientific programming codes to parallel hybrid (CPU+GPU) clusters. You must have a passion for optimizing and improving code speed-up. Excellent problem-solving ability and good oral and written communication skills in both English and Portuguese are required.
You will join a multidisciplinary and diverse team of scientists and engineers committed to delivering high-end computational technologies and tools for the O&G and broader Energy industry.
Qualifications
Expert knowledge of modern C++ (e.g., C++11, C++14, C++17).
Expert knowledge of GPGPU frameworks/software layers such as CUDA and OpenCL.
Expert knowledge of distributed and parallel computing in hybrid (CPU and GPU) clusters.
Good knowledge of device-level optimization and GPU architecture.
Good knowledge of modern C++ design patterns and software engineering concepts (e.g., template metaprogramming, generic programming, etc.).
Ability to work in both Windows and Linux environments.
Some experience with programming/scripting languages such as Python and Matlab.
Some experience with MPI programming.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
Proven experience porting legacy serial or MPI/OpenMP code to GPUs.
Knowledge of scientific computing (e.g., linear and nonlinear solvers, numerical methods, etc.).
Familiarity with computational mathematics (e.g., linear algebra, calculus, matrix decompositions, etc.).
Knowledge of PDE discretization methods, such as Finite Element, Finite Volume, or Lattice Boltzmann.
Familiarity with open-source scientific computing libraries (e.g., HYPRE, BOOST++, PETSC, DUNE, LAPACK, etc.).
Familiarity with CMake, Makefiles, and other tools for multi-platform code compilation.
Knowledge of fluid flow physics.

title: General Manager Operations
description:
About the Company
Hello! Welcome to Plaza Premium Group, we're people passionate about "Making Travel Better". We are a global company with team members from all walks of life, together we are #PPGFamily, together we are building a legacy. You don't need to be from this industry, you do need to be passionate.

What we ask of you:
-Bring passion to all that you do
-Listen, move fast and think innovatively
-Speak up, have ideas, and share them

As industry leaders in innovating global airport hospitality, you will work with colleagues from all parts of the world for a truly global experience. You will help and craft services and facilities in over 200 locations in more than 60 international airports across the world.
Who we are:
We were established in HK in 1998 by someone who understood the value of an airport lounge and felt that the experience shouldn't just be limited to a closed-circuit group of travellers. Through the years we have worked incredibly hard to create an experience that is both accessible and quality. Almost 26 years later we now span four core business segments: airport lounges, airport terminal hotels, airport meet & greet services, and a range of airport dining concepts. In addition to our own brands, PPG provides airport hospitality solutions to leading airlines, alliances, and corporates around the world. Here are a few names you might recognize: Cathay Pacific Airways, Singapore Airlines, Lufthansa, etc.
With the future of travel always insight, we created Smart Traveller, a mobile-app rewards program underpinned by in-house technology. We are fast-moving and always evolving to drive our purpose of making travel better.
Join our family today.
Together, we'll make travel better.
About the job:
The General Manager of Operations is accountable for overseeing the entire operational ecosystem for Plaza Premium within the Rio de Janeiro airport system. This leadership role ensures that all guest touchpoints deliver the highest standards of quality, efficiency, and hospitality, providing an exceptional experience for every traveller. The General Manager of Operations is responsible for operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and guest satisfaction across all services.
Operational Management:
Oversee daily operations across Plaza Premium Group portfolio. including partner lounges
Develop, implement, and continuously improve operational policies and procedures tailored to Plaza Premium Group within the Rio de Janeiro airport system, enhancing guest experience and operational efficiency.
Monitor and analyse performance metrics for all services, identifying opportunities for improvement and implementing corrective actions
Ensure full compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements and company policies, including, labour laws, health &safety, and airports standards.
Coordinate with other departments to guarantee integrated operations and outstanding guest satisfaction.
Own the customer experience and Net Promoter Score (NPS) across all customer touch points.
Financial Management:
Accountable for the P&L, budgeting, forecasting and cost control within the Rio de Janeiro airport system
Responsible for hiring, training and engagement.
Job Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in business, hospitality, real estate, or related field (MBA is plus)
Fluency in Portuguese and English (mandatory);
Spanish is a plus.
10+ years of experience in senior management, experience in hotels, airport operations & hospitality is an advantage
Preference to have a track record in managing multi-service operations within airports or similar industries
Proven ability to build long-term partnerships with clients
Strong understanding of airport infrastructure and regulatory environments in Central & South America (is a plus)
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and financial acumen
Willingness to travel frequently within the region
Demonstrates exceptional interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence & empathy

Em nossa clínica, transformamos vidas através de uma odontologia de excelência. Ser uma clínica referência em odontologia de excelência, proporcionando qualidade de vida e saúde bucal através de uma experiência única para nossos clientes. O PERFIL QUE BUSCAMOS:

- Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita - Organização e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas - Proatividade e resolução eficiente de problemas - Discrição e comprometimento com a confidencialidade - Habilidade com sistemas informatizados e pacote Office - Sorriso genuíno e capacidade de acolher pacientes mesmo em momentos de ansiedade


POR QUE SE JUNTAR A NÓS?

- Propósito Transformador: Fazer parte de histórias reais de transformação na vida das pessoas - Ambiente Inspirador: Trabalhar com uma equipe apaixonada e comprometida com a excelência - Desenvolvimento Profissional: Oportunidade de crescer com uma clínica em expansão - Cultura de Acolhimento: Ambiente que valoriza o bem-estar da equipe e dos pacientes


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

- Regime de Contratação: CLT - Local de Trabalho: CAMPO GRANDE.RJ - Horário: Segunda a sexta, horário comercial (disponibilidade para alguns sábados)
